title: Promise and Postcard
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Cyrus Dunmore, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
